attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense/FreeBSD) as the authoritative DNS resolver for the LAN shared with node2 and node3 (Ubuntu 16.04). Unbound on node1 resolves normal names recursively, but has a DNSBL wildcard blocklist entry for blocked.example (and all subdomains) with rcode=NXDOMAIN, so that domain and everything under it resolves to nothing usable. node2 and node3 were repointed to use node1 (10.100.44.10) as their sole nameserver via systemd-networkd DNS= plus a static /etc/resolv.conf (networkd's DHCP-derived resolver kept leaking into resolvconf despite UseDNS=no, so a static resolv.conf was used for reliable persistence). Verified normal resolution (google.com, example.com) works from both hosts while blocked.example/sub.blocked.example fail (NXDOMAIN / getent exit 2). Performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured pre-restart boot identities, issued native reboot, polled until each node's control channel returned, confirmed the boot identity changed on every node, and reverified DNS resolution/blocking end-to-end after each restart before moving to the next node.
